specification.source_read_policy: Read remc2 only with git show <commit>:<path>; the upstream worktree is protected and may be dirty.

source_anchors.claim: The Day map type has the serialized value 0.
The loader receives the external level number and resolves the stored internal level index.
The fixed VGA path clears and blits the 320x200 logical desktop when the selector bit is set.

inclusions: The Level 2 external-to-internal selector is explicit: external level 2 selects internal index 1.
The selected terrain is the pinned remc2 Day map type (serialized value 0).
The run is an offline campaign with local player 0 and AI opponent 1.
The owner-data language is English and owner data is required; host defaults cannot silently substitute another package.
The existing fixed desktop presentation profile is 320x200, screen-size 0, non-stereo, until a later matrix explicitly broadens it.
Level 1 remains a sealed prerequisite and every shared Level 2 change must run the fast guard.
nonclaims: This contract does not claim any Level 2 gameplay, asset, audio, AI, objective, or presentation row is implemented.
Night or Cave maps, external levels other than 2, internal indices other than 1, and any alternate map selector are outside this profile.
Network multiplayer, remote players, more than one AI opponent, or a different player ordering are outside this profile.
Alternate resolutions, stereo output, active-DAC colour, widescreen presentation, and a modern overlay are outside this profile.
Non-English owner data, missing owner data, generated fixtures, and host-inferred defaults are outside this profile.
The long Unity/PLAN29 qualification is a milestone gate, not a per-slice guard requirement.
broadening_requires: A later matrix row or explicit profile revision with source evidence at the pinned commit.
A reviewed change to this contract and its mutation-negative guard tests.
A new owner-data and presentation receipt; no Level 1 receipt may be regenerated in place.

historical_receipts.description: These hashes identify accepted Level 1 history. The guard checks them; it never regenerates or rewrites them.

current_checks.description: Current source and production-path tests may be rerun and must pass; their outputs are not promoted to historical receipts by this guard.
